Shows landholdings as of the 1790's. Depths shown by soundings. Title devised by cataloger. Manuscript--lead pencil tracings. Oriented with north to the right. Includes text and notes. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy lacks sections in center and along edges; mounted on cloth backing. Phillips. Washington 464 Vault DCP
